map.现值的计算：PV = FV ÷（1 + r)^t；贴现额 = FV − PV；贴: Present value: PV = FV ÷ (1 + r)^t; discount amount = FV − PV; discount factor = (1 + r)^t; implied annualized return = (FV ÷ PV)^(1/t) − 1, used to discount investments and notes and to back out returns.
map.20000 元、5%、10 年 → 现值约 12278.27。: 20,000 yuan at 5% over 10 years gives a present value of about 12,278.27.
map.贴现率越高现值越低。: The higher the discount rate, the lower the present value.
map.贴现决策：录入未来金额与贴现率，算现值判断是否值得。: Discounting decisions: enter the future amount and the discount rate, compute the present value and judge whether it is worth it.
map.债券估值：对多期票息+本金贴现求现值。: Bond valuation: discount several periods of coupons plus principal to get the present value.
map.教学演示：演示贴现率越高现值越低。: Teaching demo: show that a higher discount rate gives a lower present value.
map.示例：1 年后 11000、贴现率 10%，PV=11000/1.1=10000: Example: 11,000 one year later at a 10% discount rate gives PV = 11000/1.1 = 10000.
map.贴现率怎么定？: How is the discount rate set?
map.用资金机会成本或要求回报率，越高现值越低，是核心假设。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测: Use the opportunity cost of funds or the required return; the higher it is, the lower the present value, and it is the core assumption. map.和终值？: How does it relate to future value?
map.现值是终值按贴现率往回折，二者互逆（PV×(1+r)^t=FV）。结果仅作经济学: Present value is the future value discounted back, and the two are inverse (PV × (1+r)^t = FV). Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
